text: Bitcoin is holding steady near $82k with modest gains, while Ethereum is outpacing it with a 1.5% rise, suggesting modest risk appetite toward altcoins despite Bitcoin's dominance remaining elevated at 59.2%. The Fear & Greed index sits at neutral (53) but has declined 11 points over the week, indicating growing caution despite the solid $34.3 trillion trading volume. The mixed performance across majors—with smaller caps like SOL also gaining—reflects a market in consolidation without strong directional conviction.
